entryPointCandidates.name: server.mjs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Trident's entry point: a local HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 that wires together the gate, Codex, OpenRouter, Library, settings and workplaces, streams every event to the page over server-sent events, and handles the POST routes for workplaces, messages, approvals, plans, interrupts, Library actions and settings.

entryPointCandidates.name: README.md
entryPointCandidates.summary: Project overview explaining Trident's Lead/worker/cross-check model, workplaces, Ask several, Library and approvals, plus requirements (Node 26, git, Claude/Codex logins), setup, optional OpenRouter keys, folder layout, work flow diagram, status and privacy notes.

entryPointCandidates.name: team.mjs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Core worker-team orchestrator: assigns Lead tasks to Claude, Codex, or OpenRouter workers in isolated git worktrees, gates risky edits, broadcasts file-edit notes and clash warnings, runs cross-vendor review rounds, and merges or rejects results.

entryPointCandidates.name: workplaces.mjs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Manages multiple isolated workplaces (each with its own folder, board, Lead, team and compare node) persisted in data/workplaces.json, handling create, remove/archive, goal cancellation and folder validation.

entryPointCandidates.name: appserver.mjs
entryPointCandidates.summary: Spike that drives `codex app-server` over stdio JSON-RPC with a long-lived thread, timing startup and two turns and declining any server approval requests.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Project overview explaining Trident's Lead/worker/cross-check model, workplaces, Ask several, Library and approvals, plus requirements (Node 26, git, Claude/Codex logins), setup, optional OpenRouter keys, folder layout, work flow diagram, status and privacy notes.

documentation.name: agent-collab-teardown.md
documentation.summary: Research teardown comparing how Band, Coral and PandaOS coordinate AI agents (chat-room @mentions, task board with proof of completion, Director router) and the ideas Trident borrows from each.

documentation.name: design.md
documentation.summary: Design document for Trident: the problem, the Lead-plan-approve-worker-cross-check-merge flow, the engine pieces (SDK adapters, team tools, SQLite board, worktrees, approval gate, state snapshot), the interface sketch, milestones M1-M4 and open questions.

config.name: launch.json

config.name: config.json
config.summary: Understand-Anything tool settings that fix the knowledge-graph output language to English.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: npm manifest for the private ES-module Trident package; `npm start` runs src/server.mjs and the only dependencies are the Claude Agent SDK and the Codex SDK.

list.name: Server and Workplaces
list.description: The local 127.0.0.1 HTTP entry point plus the workplace manager and Trident-wide settings store that wire each workplace's board, Lead, team and compare node together.

list.name: Agent Orchestration
list.description: The Lead agent session, the cross-vendor worker team that builds in git worktrees and cross-checks work, the side-by-side compare node, and the approval gate that holds risky tool calls for the user.

list.name: Model Providers
list.description: Adapters that turn the Claude Agent SDK, the long-lived Codex app-server and the OpenRouter route into message-at-a-time worker sessions.

list.name: Agent Tool Servers
list.description: In-process MCP servers that give agents board actions (plans, tasks, assignment), team-talk messaging and Library read/write tools.

list.name: Storage and Workspace State
list.description: Persistent state behind the agents: the SQLite board of goals, tasks and talk, the draft-then-approve Markdown Library folder, and git worktree plumbing for worker workspaces.

list.name: Web Interface
list.description: The single-page Trident UI (workplaces sidebar, Lead chat, approvals bar, task board, Library and Settings) styled by the Ember design-system stylesheet.

list.name: Spikes and Probes
list.description: Standalone experiment and check scripts that confirm SDK logins, Codex app-server behaviour, OpenRouter keys and models, timing, and an end-to-end team run against the live server.

list.name: Docs and Configuration
list.description: The README, the design document and agent-collaboration teardown, plus the npm manifest, Claude Code launch config and tooling settings that start and describe Trident.

file:src/claude.mjs.name: claude.mjs
file:src/claude.mjs.summary: Wraps the Claude Agent SDK query() into a long-lived, message-at-a-time Claude worker session whose run(text) resolves with the final reply; also builds a subscription-only environment that strips stray Anthropic API overrides.

file:src/compare.mjs.name: compare.mjs
file:src/compare.mjs.summary: Side-by-side model comparison node: sends one question to up to four sources (local Claude, local Codex, or any OpenRouter model) in parallel and emits their answers with timing and cost.

file:src/git.mjs.name: git.mjs
file:src/git.mjs.summary: Git plumbing for worker workspaces: initializes the workspace repo, creates per-task worktrees on their own branches, reports diffs, merges accepted branches, and removes worktrees, all committed under a local Trident identity.

file:src/library-tools.mjs.name: library-tools.mjs
file:src/library-tools.mjs.summary: Builds an in-process MCP server exposing list/read/write tools over the shared Markdown Library to Claude-harness agents, where writes become unsaved drafts the user approves.

file:src/talk-tools.mjs.name: talk-tools.mjs
file:src/talk-tools.mjs.summary: Builds an in-process MCP server with say/read team-talk tools for Claude-harness workers, plus a digest helper that surfaces unread board messages without ever waking other agents.

file:src/team.mjs.name: team.mjs
file:src/team.mjs.summary: Core worker-team orchestrator: assigns Lead tasks to Claude, Codex, or OpenRouter workers in isolated git worktrees, gates risky edits, broadcasts file-edit notes and clash warnings, runs cross-vendor review rounds, and merges or rejects results.

file:src/workplaces.mjs.name: workplaces.mjs
file:src/workplaces.mjs.summary: Manages multiple isolated workplaces (each with its own folder, board, Lead, team and compare node) persisted in data/workplaces.json, handling create, remove/archive, goal cancellation and folder validation.

file:src/codex.mjs.name: codex.mjs
file:src/codex.mjs.summary: Codex worker adapter that keeps one long-lived codex app-server process running and talks to it over JSON-RPC on stdio, giving the rest of Trident per-thread conversations, approval forwarding and out-of-usage tracking.

file:src/library.mjs.name: library.mjs
file:src/library.mjs.summary: The shared Markdown Library: a plain folder of notes in sections that every agent can read, where every change is first stored as a draft and only becomes the real note when the user saves it, with replaced versions kept under .old.

file:src/openrouter.mjs.name: openrouter.mjs
file:src/openrouter.mjs.summary: OpenRouter integration that reads the API key and model from the process or Windows user environment and builds the environment that points the Claude Agent SDK worker at OpenRouter's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, plus a no-cost key and model check.

file:src/server.mjs.name: server.mjs
file:src/server.mjs.summary: Trident's entry point: a local HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1 that wires together the gate, Codex, OpenRouter, Library, settings and workplaces, streams every event to the page over server-sent events, and handles the POST routes for workplaces, messages, approvals, plans, interrupts, Library actions and settings.

file:src/settings.mjs.name: settings.mjs
file:src/settings.mjs.summary: Trident-wide settings store kept in data/settings.json, currently holding the maximum number of workers per workplace, with validation and a settings event on every change.

file:src/board-tools.mjs.name: board-tools.mjs
file:src/board-tools.mjs.summary: Defines the in-process MCP server of board tools the Lead agent calls (propose_plan, update_task, finish_goal, assign_task, accept_task, reject_task, ask_several, team_say), so the Lead changes the board and team only through validated tool calls.

file:src/board.mjs.name: board.mjs
file:src/board.mjs.summary: SQLite-backed board store (via node:sqlite) holding goals, their tasks and team talk; handles schema creation and column migrations, plan proposal, task updates, and renders the [state] block fed to the Lead.

file:src/gate.mjs.name: gate.mjs
file:src/gate.mjs.summary: Approval gate that holds an agent's risky tool calls until the user allows or denies them, persisting 'always allow' and 'always deny' rules per exact operation to a JSON file.

file:src/lead.mjs.name: lead.mjs
file:src/lead.mjs.summary: Runs the Lead agent as one long-lived Claude Agent SDK session fed by an async message queue, wiring in board and library MCP tools and the approval gate, and streaming its output as UI events; also exports a one-line tool-call summarizer.

file:.claude/autoharness/requests.name: requests
file:.claude/autoharness/requests.summary: Tiny runtime counter file used by the autoharness Claude Code plugin to queue skill-learning requests; it holds a single character and no project logic.

config:.claude/launch.json.name: launch.json
config:.claude/launch.json.summary: Claude Code launch configuration that starts the Trident engine with `node src/server.mjs` and points the preview at http://127.0.0.1:4317.

config:.ua/config.json.summary: Understand-Anything tool settings that fix the knowledge-graph output language to English.

document:docs/design.md.summary: Design document for Trident: the problem, the Lead-plan-approve-worker-cross-check-merge flow, the engine pieces (SDK adapters, team tools, SQLite board, worktrees, approval gate, state snapshot), the interface sketch, milestones M1-M4 and open questions.

file:public/ember.css.name: ember.css
file:public/ember.css.summary: Ember design-system stylesheet for the web page: dark warm oklch color tokens, radius and glass/shadow variables, and ds-* component styles for buttons, inputs, cards, badges, alerts, switches, tabs, steppers, sliders, tables and chips, with touch, small-screen and hover media rules.

file:public/index.html.name: index.html
file:public/index.html.summary: Single-page Trident interface: sidebar of workplaces plus Library and Settings views, a Lead chat, a Needs-you approvals bar, the goal/task board, team talk, activity log and Ask-several comparison columns, all driven by an inline script that consumes the server's /events stream and posts actions back.

file:spikes/appserver.mjs.name: appserver.mjs
file:spikes/appserver.mjs.summary: Spike that drives `codex app-server` over stdio JSON-RPC with a long-lived thread, timing startup and two turns and declining any server approval requests.

file:spikes/claude.mjs.name: claude.mjs
file:spikes/claude.mjs.summary: Spike confirming the Claude Agent SDK runs on the existing Claude Code login, sending one isolated prompt with settings, plugins and MCP servers disabled.

file:spikes/codex.mjs.name: codex.mjs
file:spikes/codex.mjs.summary: Spike confirming the Codex SDK runs on the existing Codex login by streaming one read-only turn and printing events and usage.

file:spikes/e2e-team.mjs.name: e2e-team.mjs
file:spikes/e2e-team.mjs.summary: End-to-end script against the running server: sends a request, auto-approves the plan and every approval, and logs board, message, talk, tool and status events from the /events stream until the goal is done.

file:spikes/or-check.mjs.name: or-check.mjs
file:spikes/or-check.mjs.summary: Free check of the configured OpenRouter key and model: runs the config's validity check and prints account tier and usage from the key-info endpoint without generating text.

file:spikes/or-models.mjs.name: or-models.mjs
file:spikes/or-models.mjs.summary: Lists tool-capable coding models from the public OpenRouter catalog with prices, and reports whether given model ids are still listed.

file:spikes/or-route.mjs.name: or-route.mjs
file:spikes/or-route.mjs.summary: Checks the OpenRouter route with a deliberately invalid placeholder key, expecting both the key check and a Claude-session worker turn to be refused, at no cost.

file:spikes/twoturn.mjs.name: twoturn.mjs
file:spikes/twoturn.mjs.summary: Spike measuring whether SDK slowness is a one-time startup cost or per-message, using one streaming Claude session with two messages or two Codex runs on one thread.
